entries.summary: The chat composer is redesigned as a floating card: model and effort sit in the card, workspace, toolsets, and profile tuck underneath, and new chats start with the composer centred and glide it into place when you send.
Status now rides on a tab above the composer: the running response, dictation, YOLO mode, queued messages, connection problems, and context compression, sliding in and out as they start and end.
When the server cannot be reached, the composer says so, retries with growing waits, counts down to the next try, and offers Retry now.
Scrolling up through a conversation flattens the composer to one row so you can read more; clicking or typing in it brings it back.
The terminal toggle now sits in the chat header.
Sending a message while scrolled up now returns the conversation to its latest message.
